'''Professor Nigel Robert Badnell''' (27 October 1958 – 3 September 2024) was a British physicist, at [[University of Strathclyde]] and an Elected Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/badnellnigelprof/|title=Nigel Badnell |publisher=strathclyde.ac.uk|accessdate=December 1, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2016&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellow Archive|publisher=American Physical Society|accessdate=December 1, 2019}}</ref>
